contentBody.description: Complete the customer requirements questionnaire for Gaudi. This evaluation will help walk you through if Gaudi is a match for the customer's workload and future business solutions.

sections.content:
Please click here to go to the Generative AI Questionnaire located within Seismic
https://intel.seismic.com/Link/Content/DCdfR4PPpj27CGqXHpqC7CXcD2Hd

Once on the document in Seismic, click on the "Add to Workspace" button in the top right corner. Then add the questionnaire to "My Files".

Navigate to your Workspace, click the 3 dots on the right side of the document and click "copy to" to your files again. Rename the copy of the document to "Generative AI Questionnaire - YOUR OPPORTNITY NAME". Then proceed to fill out the form.

Once your form is completed, click the 3 dots on the right side again and click "Share externally". Utilize the Live send feature within Seismic to send the completed questionnaire to the following PDL: smg.dcai.gtm.ai.end.customer@intel.com
sections.keyConcept: Fill out the Questionnaire and share with opportunity team
